It includes post1648j only at candidate status, so the obstruction below is stronger than the audited-core statement but is not itself audited authority.

frozen_package.absence_ceiling: No repository-wide or literature-wide absence claim. Only this explicitly named package is frozen.

strongest_admissible_identification_enum.interpretation: This is the exact target-inner ambiguity remaining after imposing the strongest currently available +r differential/generator-orbit candidate. It is not a claim that a source-bound integral homology marking has been constructed.
strongest_admissible_identification_enum.delta_transport_rule: phi2*phi6 fixes Z3 uniquely; under a candidate identification indexed by h, its image h*(S*T^-1)*h^-1 fixes h(L2) uniquely, so delta_0inf maps to h(L2).

residual_ambiguity_group_action.consequence: The cross-identification arrow left unbound by the frozen package has a transitive three-line orbit. The six source-to-W bijections occur with multiplicity four in the 24 projective ordered-pair classes, and delta_0inf occurs eight times on each line.

compatibility_with_other_frozen_lanes.ppav_CM: EX4-04 exhausts 48 principal-polarized Z[r]-linear target identifications; their W action is full S3, so ppav+CM does not reduce the orbit.
compatibility_with_other_frozen_lanes.differential_period: EX4-05 gives one projective differential intertwiner for the literal plus-r representative, but composing with G produces the full target-inner family; the missing homology/A-period normalization does not select h.
compatibility_with_other_frozen_lanes.FSM_theta_level: EX4-05B provides no semantic adapter from elliptic level data to the branch-labelled Bolza J[2] marking. Its optional anti-isometry ambiguity reduces mod2 to full S3 and therefore supplies no selector.
compatibility_with_other_frozen_lanes.Galois_semilinear: EX4-05C leaves six W-trivial involutive retained real-structure lifts, two for each possible residual invariant line. Because the frozen package does not source-bind one exact retained lift, this lane does not collapse the three-line orbit.
compatibility_with_other_frozen_lanes.direct_divisor: EX4-05D makes delta_0inf explicit as the half-divisor of x, but gives no retained F2^4 coordinate, so it labels the source class without selecting its target line.

bounded_obstruction.audited_core_reason: The stronger package adds candidate/scratch constraints to the audited core and still has all three line images; therefore the audited subset cannot select a unique line either.
bounded_obstruction.scope_warning: This is only a bounded EX4 source-package obstruction candidate. It is not a theorem that no future source, literature result, period computation, or new geometric adapter can select the line.
